title: Will this demand forecast work next month?
scenario: A retail forecasting notebook predicts daily demand. It builds a centered seven-day target average and evaluates with a shuffled random row holdout. Choose an evaluation strategy and identify the evidence that could make the reported error optimistic.
codeExcerpt:
df['demand_7d_centered'] = df.groupby('store_id')['demand'].transform(lambda values: values.rolling(7, center=True).mean())
train, test = train_test_split(df, test_size=0.2, random_state=1729, shuffle=True)
